forgotPassword.step2Title: We sent you a code to reset your password

language.title: Select your language
language.info: This will help us personalize your Yapper experience.

interests.title: What are you interested in?
interests.info: Select at least 3 interests to help us tailor your feed.

mutualFollowers.noMutuals: Not followed by anyone you are following
mutualFollowers.followedByMultiple: Followed by {name} and {count} others you follow

noPosts.title: No posts yet
noPosts.description: When this user posts, they'll show up here.

noReplies.title: No replies yet
noReplies.description: When this user replies to posts, they'll show up here.

noMedia.title: No media yet
noMedia.description: Photos and videos will appear here.

noLikes.title: No likes yet
noLikes.description: When this user likes posts, they'll show up here.

blocked.title: {username} is blocked
blocked.description: Are you sure you want to view these posts? Viewing posts won't unblock {username}.

muted.message: You have muted posts from this account.

block.title: Block
block.description: They will be able to see your public posts, but will no longer be able to engage with them. {username} will also not be able to follow or message you, and you will not see notifications from them.

unblock.title: Unblock
unblock.description: They will be able to follow you and engage with your public posts.

unfollow.title: Unfollow
unfollow.description: Their posts will no longer show up in your Following timeline. You can still view their profile, unless their posts are protected.

unmute.title: UnMute
unmute.description: Posts from this account will now be allowed in your Home timeline.

removeFollower.title: Remove
removeFollower.description: {username} will be removed from your followers and won't be notified by Yappper. They can follow you again in the future.

noFollowers.title: No followers yet
noFollowers.description: When someone follows this account, they'll show up here.

noFollowing.title: Not following anyone yet
noFollowing.description: When this account follows people, they'll show up here.

privacy.likesPrivate: Your likes are private. Only you can see them.

settings.yourAccount_desc: See information about your account, download an archive of your data, or learn about your account deletion.
settings.accountInformation_desc: See your account information like your username and email address.
settings.changePassword_desc: Change your password at any time.
settings.deleteYourAccount_desc: Find out how you can delete your account.

accountInfo.title: Account information
accountInfo.birthDate_desc: Change your date of birth on your profile.
accountInfo.age_desc_long: If you haven’t provided a date of birth, we’ve provided an age range based on your Yapper profile and activity. Age information is used to personalize your experience.
accountInfo.age_notRight: Not right? You can add your date of birth to your profile without sharing it publicly.

languages.title: Languages
languages.manage_desc: Manage which languages are used to personalize your Yapper experience.
languages.selectAppLanguage_desc: This will be your default language in the app. You’ll see content we think you’ll like in the other languages you chose, too.

settings.privacyAndSafety_desc: Manage your privacy and safety settings on Yapper.
settings.muteAndBlock_desc: Manage the accounts and notifications that you have muted or blocked.
settings.blockedAccounts_desc: When you block someone, that person won’t be able to follow or message you, and you won’t see notifications from them.
settings.mutedAccounts_desc: Here’s everyone you muted. You can add or remove them from this list.
settings.displayAndLanguages_desc: Manage how Yapper content is displayed to you.
settings.display_desc: Manage your font color and background. These settings affect all the Yapper accounts on this browser.
settings.display_desc2: Manage your font size, color, and background. These settings affect all the Yapper accounts on this browser.
settings.useSystemSetting_desc: Your theme will automatically switch based on your device settings.
